summary: Frontend-only test of the clarity pass + workspace re-layout. I ran Playwright at 1920 and 390 px. To get partner answers and preview states quickly, a helper script set them up through the API (/app/tests/assemble_state.py). Every requested feature works. Six minor issues remain, all copy or consistency: the conditions count differs between the checker rule and the plan strip, the result pill is cut off on mobile, a grammar slip, a '(Synthetic)' tag leaking into error text, '+$0' in the amendment lead, and unused dead code.
verified_passing: Login: brand is text-[31px]/sm:text-[36px], about 29% larger than the header (24/28px). The 'Organizer' button signs in to /project.

Plan strip on every step: the result pill reads 'Schedule and budget fit' (A+B+C $168,000), 'Schedule or budget fails' (Alder+Redwood $156,000) or 'No candidate yet'. Total '$168,000 of $180,000', responses '0 of 3' / '2 of 3' / '3 of 3', conditions amber 'N open'.

Plan strip next buttons all route correctly: Prepare a draft -> draft; Repair the draft -> draft with draft-repair-notice; Create review links -> ask; See partner status; Review open conditions -> decide-open-conditions; Review proposed changes -> amendment panel scrolled to top; Handle change requests after a discard.

Checker panel: failing rules and the conditions rule ('N open') are listed first. Passed rules are collapsed under 'View checks · N passed' (7 for a passing plan, 6 when failing). The note reads 'One workable arrangement; other arrangements may exist.' The preview checker panel behaves the same.

Partner cards: no status pill before a link exists. Copy button aria-label is 'Copy review link for Alder Line Electric'. After answering: 'Answered these terms <time>'. After the amendment is selected: Alder shows 'Answered previous terms; revised terms await review.' The Ask step checkmark appears only when all partners answered the current terms (0 checkmarks at 2/3, 1 at 3/3, 0 after the amendment).
With a preview open: draft-preview-open-notice appears, the Generate button is disabled, and draft-open-preview-button goes to Decide.

Amendment panel: eyebrow 'Proposed changes · preview v2 · not selected'. Lead reads '2 sites change · +$4,000 · Alder Line Electric, Dogwood Field Crews must review · 1 already awaiting a response'. Diff headers are 'Current plan' / 'Proposed'. The unchanged-partners toggle and the editor toggle are collapsed by default; the editor stays collapsed after a clean save.
Select dialog separates 'Changed by this amendment, must review: Alder, Dogwood' from 'Already awaiting a response (not caused by this change): Cedar'.

Amendment safeguards still work: unsaved edits disable Select ('Save and recheck...'); a failing preview is blocked; a -$100,000 discount is rejected; the Dogwood repair gives $172,000 and passes; Select creates v2; Discard works; Reset works.

Check this job: a new registered account with no sites opens on the 'Read a document' tab. Readings are sorted with active items first; applied items collapse under readings-done-toggle 'Already used or rejected · 3'.
Legacy 'Conditions' fact (scope partner, no partner_name, invalid; inserted directly into Mongo) is migrated to a selectable 'Job condition', and applying it works.
Guided tour state note appears at plan v1 with a preview open, and again at plan v2 $172,000.
Summary order: decision, conditions (Outstanding work), contributions, responses, checks (Supporting checks). The conditions rule shows '2 open', not Pass.

Mobile 390px: plan strip is 2 columns (178px each). No horizontal page overflow on any step, on the amendment panel with the editor open, or on Summary; schedule and diff tables scroll inside their own containers.

ui_bugs.issue: Conditions counts disagree. The plan strip and Summary Decision count openConditions(cur), which includes partner response conditions (e.g. '4 open'). The checker 'conditions' rule pill and Summary 'Supporting checks' use only checker.open_conditions ('2 open'). Both counts show on the same screen. Before any draft, the strip also shows gap.open_conditions (3), which drops to 2 after the draft.
Grammar: '1 partner have no review link yet.' should be 'has'.
Backend error text keeps the fixture tag: 'Price adjustment for Cedar Grid Services (Synthetic): ...'. untag() only runs on successful responses, not on error payloads.
Shows '+$0' when the total is unchanged (customer change only moves weeks). 'total unchanged' would read better.

issues: The 'Schedule and budget fit' pill is clipped to 'Schedule and budget fi' in the 178px cell (Cell has overflow/min-w-0 and the pill is nowrap). Allow wrapping or shorten the label on mobile.

design_issues.screen: Check this job / Read a document
issues: The Document date field uses the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar.

action_items: Unify the conditions count: either include response conditions in ruleView for the 'conditions' rule, or label the strip/decision counts separately (e.g. 'stated' vs 'from responses').
Fix the plural in nextStep: 'has' for 1 partner.
Apply untag() to error response payloads (err.response.data) in the api interceptor.
Prevent the plan-strip result pill from clipping at 390px.
Optional: show 'total unchanged' instead of '+$0' in the amend lead; remove the unused OVERALL export in format.js (still has 'Passes every check').
critical_code_review_comments: format.js exports OVERALL with 'Passes every check' but nothing uses it. It is dead code that could be reintroduced by accident.
nextStep's openConditions(cur) and CheckerPanel.ruleView use different condition sources, which causes the mismatched counts.
IntakeTask reads the default tab from sessionStorage ('assemble_intake_tab') before checking the sites heuristic, so a tab picked in an earlier job carries over within the same browser session.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested features pass; 6 minor issues

seed_data_creation: Demo sandboxes: visitor_ids vtest-ui-b1 (reset, then a failing Alder+Redwood v1), vtest-ui-c1 (v2 $172,000 after the Dogwood repair), vtest-ui-d1 (readings plus injected legacy fact fact_legacytest01, then applied), vtest-a1. Also registered test_reg_<ts>@example.com with project 'TEST job'.
flaky_tests: Clicking signin-demo-organizer-button immediately after reload (during the fade-in) sometimes did not navigate (1 of about 10 runs). Waiting for :not([disabled]) plus 800ms fixed it. This looks like test timing, not an app bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use python /app/tests/assemble_state.py <visitor_id> draft links answer:alder,birch preview (env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) to jump a sandbox to a given state, then log in through the UI with localStorage assemble_visitor=<visitor_id> and assemble_tour_closed=1. The first id given to answer: gets a response condition.
